exposure: Strength of preference for vaginal birth
strength of preference for vaginal birth
cohort: 210 pregnant women who were <36 weeks' pregnant
finding: Among women who attempt a vaginal delivery, the strength of preference for vaginal birth is predictive of the delivery mode ultimately undergone.
mod_finding: Among women who attempt a vaginal delivery, the strength of preference for vaginal birth is predictive of the delivery mode ultimately undergone.
